newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: INDIA TENDERS TO BUY 1.0-PCT, 0.5-PCT OCT DIESEL.
newsitem.headline: INDIA TENDERS TO BUY 1.0-PCT, 0.5-PCT OCT DIESEL.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) has issued a tender to buy high speed diesel for deliveries in October, traders said on Thursday.
The tender seeks 0.5-percent sulphur diesel for deliveries to Madras or Haldia on the east coast and 1.0-percent sulphur grade for delivery to the east coast and to Kandla on the west coast.
The tender closes on August 21 and offers will be valied until August 22.
IOC bought a meagre 90,000 tonnes of 1.0-percent sulphur diesel in its last tender for September delivery, which was well below even the most conservative expectation of 200,000 tonnes.
